description: List a calendar for a date range, soonest first. Without agent_id: the user's OWN calendar (calendar_events with no agent) merged with their booked meetings. With agent_id: that agent's calendar only (no meetings). user_id defaults to the authenticated caller (required under API-key auth). Optional: from/to (ISO), include_meetings (default true), agent_id.

agent_id.description: An agent's calendar (omit = the user's own)

include_meetings.description: Merge booked meetings (default true; user calendar only)

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return

name: list_calendar_events
